UxPlay 1.74 is distributed with PadMirror as a separate GPLv3 process.

Upstream project: https://github.com/FDH2/UxPlay
Bundled revision: 8fa09eaec76a64726fd21becad5dcc82a4c0851c

PadMirror modification: lib/mdnsd/mdnsd.c accepts UXPLAY_MDNS_IPV4 so the
receiver can advertise on the selected physical LAN interface instead of a
lower-metric Hyper-V or WSL adapter.

PadMirror modification: lib/mdnsd/dnssd_mdnsd.c accepts UXPLAY_MDNS_HOST so
the AirPlay service uses a stable host name that cannot collide with a Windows
hostname advertised by Tailscale or another network adapter.

PadMirror audio modifications: lib/raop_rtp.c clears the RAOP jitter buffer
when the sender issues FLUSH, and renderers/audio_renderer.c bounds the audio
queue and resets its GStreamer pipeline at that discontinuity. This prevents
pre-seek audio from playing seconds behind the new video position.

PadMirror video modification: uxplay.cpp and renderers/video_renderer.[ch]
add separate -vrtp264 and -vrtp265 forwarding pipelines. H.264 and HEVC RTP
are sent to distinct localhost ports so PadMirror can negotiate and decode
either codec without treating HEVC packets as H.264.

The corresponding source archive is included in the release bundle. Build it
with MSYS2 UCRT64, CMake and Ninja using -DNO_MARCH_NATIVE=ON.
